<p class="section-lede">My research spans efficient knowledge graph retrieval, multi-agent clinical reasoning, and interpretable and robust anomaly detection.</p>

::: {.projects-page .content-grid}
::: {.content-card}
### [Orchestrator-Centered Multi-Agent Systems for Clinical Reasoning](projects/multi-agent-clinical-reasoning/)

Specialized large language model agents generate, review, and refine diagnostic predictions through structured multi-step interactions, coordinated by a reinforcement-learning orchestrator.

<span>Multi-Agent Systems</span><span>LLMs</span><span>Reinforcement Learning</span><span>Clinical AI</span>
:::

### [CFDet](projects/cfdet/)

Counterfactual explanations for sequence anomaly detection that identify minimal changes needed to convert an anomalous sequence into a normal one.

[Paper](https://link.springer.com/chapter/10.1007/978-3-031-70371-3_2) · [Code](https://github.com/Serendipity618/CFDet)

::: {.tag-list}
<span>Anomaly Detection</span><span>Counterfactual Explanation</span><span>Sequence Modeling</span>
:::
:::
